case.question: What is LocalBridge MCP?

m26.answer_text: With LocalBridge, Daniel can let an online assistant work against his local environment without opening a separate coding agent for every task. The useful jobs are local file inspection, editing, repo cleanup, running bounded shell commands, checking logs, moving artifacts, and coordinating multi-step work that normally requires a terminal or local IDE. In product terms, LocalBridge turns ChatGPT or Claude into a supervised local work surface: the model can read, modify, test and report, while the user keeps control over access, review and risky side effects.
